title: Parse without allocating
prompt: Implement `static (int a, int b) ParsePair(ReadOnlySpan<char> input)` that parses two comma-separated integers from the span WITHOUT allocating any string. No Split, no Substring — slice and parse the span directly. The test measures allocations to prove it.

tests.name: correctness
tests.hint: Slice at the comma: input[..i] and input[(i+1)..], then int.Parse each slice.

tests.name: zero-alloc
tests.hint: int.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>) never allocates; the tuple fits in registers/stack.
